newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian Bemextours to boost business in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Bemextours to boost business in 1997.

text.p: Croatia's biggest tour operator Bemextours said on Monday it planned to boost business in 1997, by bringing a total of 100,000 foreign holidaymakers to Croatian seaside resorts, state radio reported.
It quoted Bemextours' European directors as saying the tour operator would organise 14 charter flights a week from Great Britain, Germany, the Czech Republic, Slovakia and France.
They would be flown to the central and southern Adriatic from early May to mid-October next year.
Bemextours plans to fly more than 25,000 tourists to the area of the southern port of Dubrovnik alone.
So far this year, it has brought 55,000 European visitors to the Croatian coast and counts on another 5,000 by the end of December.
Croatia has cashed in almost $2 billion from tourist trade this year, according to official figures. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
